column1: # PostgreSQL-style SQL prototype: the write corpus of the id rule (fork issue #38).
# Same columns and rules as writes.tsv (read its header): id, status, checks, statement, expected. An id that starts with err- is a statement the server must refuse.

# The rule for writes: the record id column (id in a type with no property id, rid in a type with its own id) is never settable, SQLSTATE 428C9. A property named id or rid is the user's data and is set like any other column.

# data: the idrule fixture of idrule.tsv. The server gets the tables of the relational view (SmallSchemaSql) and then idrule-writes.sql, which makes the record id column generated (428C9) and gives a new row one from a sequence, as the table view does.
# expected: written by the generator from the real server, never by hand.
